sections.text: Introduction

This document out line the equipment
inspection checklist I3, which must be performed every two years as indicated by 
Y2 in the title block.

Each blow down sump is equipped with two blow down sump pumps, which is 
vertically mounted submerged pumps, these pumps discharge the condensate to waste treatment system.

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Work order must be issued and the 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
the work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves, earplugs etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of pump
motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of
motor.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out

Tighten all 
loose bolts and check for excessive vibration & listen for abnormal 
noise, then change any of the defected internal parts.

Check 
pump discharge press.

Relubricate pump bearing and check bearing temperature (max 85 ◦C) and 
change the bearing if needed.

Clean impeller from excessive erosion, corrosion or cracking by removing the 
layer of corrosion and repairing the cracks by welding and make balance.
Check bearing cleaning housing to prevent any deposits

Check alignment between motor shaft and pump, readjust again and operate the 
pump to check the work.
